01: Grandma, when will the Day of Judgement come? Tomorrow?!
02: Nobody knows that except Allah. But the Prophet, sallallahu alayhi wa sallam, told us some of its signs.
03: One sign: shepherds of black camels will compete with each other in building higher and higher buildings.
04: Once, that desert had only tents. Now look.
05: So the Hour is close? I'm scared!
06: Don't be scared. Be ready. Worship Allah as if you see Him. And if you don't see Him, He sees you.
07: Then I'll start right now, with my next prayer.
